# Zydis and Zycore

The parts of Zydis the core builds (its headers, `src/` with its generated tables) and its
licence, copied unchanged from https://github.com/zyantific/zydis at commit
120e0e705f8e3b507dc49377ac2879979f0d545c; and in `dependencies/zycore`, the same of Zycore,
from https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c at commit 38d4f0285e6157ee840ea82a9b90aba71c8a705d
(the one Zydis pointed at). To move them on, copy the same files from newer commits over these.
